Large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity **don’t have an edit button** that lets you directly correct inaccurate business information in their responses.
Fixing outdated AI data requires **updating the sources the AI pulls from**, including your own website, Google Business Profile, local listings and other third-party directories.
**• Regularly Audit Your AI Presence** – Query major AI platforms using common user questions about your pricing, location, business hours and services to catch any inaccurate brand information.
**• Document Every Hallucination or Misinformation** – Take screenshots, timestamps and save the specific prompts used to create an evidence trail for tracking fixes over time.
**• Trace the Sources AI Is Citing** – Check real-time citations or run targeted search queries to pinpoint the specific sources causing the misinformation.
**• Correct the Outdated Information at the Source**– Update your website, clean up directory listings, align your Google and Bing business profiles and add schema markup to establish a unified source of truth.
**• Create Fresh Content That Contradicts Outdated Data** – Regularly publish up-to-date content on your site to provide AI systems with strong, recent signals that actively overwrite old data.
**• Establish Ongoing Cross-Platform Monitoring** – Set a quarterly schedule to audit AI platforms and catch new hallucinations before they compound.
